Your live report arrives every week of the pilot.</p>\n<div class=\"rpt\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Sample Monday report\">\n<div class=\"rph\"><div><span class=\"lab red\">Monday report</span><b>Barboursville Vineyards</b></div><span class=\"rpd\">Sample: the last two weeks &middot; read November 8, 2026</span></div>\n<div class=\"rpk\"><div><b>17</b><span>new reviews</span></div><div><b>4.9<small>&#9733;</small></b><span>average</span></div><div><b>14</b><span>with written comments</span></div><div><b>0</b><span>replies posted</span></div></div>\n<div class=\"rpc\"><div><h4>What guests praised</h4><ul><li>Library 1821: the tasting, the glasses and the deck</li><li>Two team members named by guests: Mark in the tasting room and Alessandro at Palladio</li><li>Palladio&rsquo;s food, and a team that made a tight lunch timeframe work</li><li>The cheese and charcuterie platter</li></ul></div><div><h4>What guests needed</h4><ul><li>Vintages differ between Palladio and the tasting room. Jefferson mentions him by name in his letters. I named my studio for him.</p>\n<p>I worked in a Charlottesville tasting room and saw how much of a great team&rsquo;s day goes to answering the same questions. lb.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape'||e.key==='Tab'){e.preventDefault();if(e.key==='Escape')lbclose()}});}
md.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===md)mclose()});
md.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape'){mclose();return}if(e.key==='Tab'){var f=md.querySelectorAll('a[href],button');var a=f[0],z=f[f.length-1];if(e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===a){e.preventDefault();z.focus()}else if(!e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===z){e.preventDefault();a.focus()}}});
})();
})();
